metadata.family: Independent shared response for each physical bank x string, one signed force per crossing; equal-pitch bank contributions sum in mono.
metadata.fit_scope: Same supplied 47.624807256s mono recording; in-sample fitting, no independent validation, no source mixing or authenticity/biomechanical feasibility claim.
metadata.geometry_assumptions: Two ordered 21-string banks B 0..20, A 26..46, nonsounding six-spacing gap; 21+21 D-pentatonic tuning hypothetical. Full 42 points retained, only inherited six-pitch modal dictionary excited.
metadata.initial_state: One complex state per observed mode per five recording-resume intervals, tau=1.5s; aggregate initial state not assigned arbitrarily to a bank.
metadata.prior_version_caveat: v6 was A-only. v4/v5 allowed interior reversals/stops. v6/v7 reset ringing at recording gaps; v4/v5 masked gaps but let old contacts decay after resume.
metadata.search_bound_change: Maximum speed remains 50 string-spacings/s. Max half-cycle expanded explicitly from v6 0.9s to v7 2.0s so larger spans can be traversed slowly. Not video-calibrated.

analytic_route.orientation_definition: +1 pitch index rises with spatial coordinate; -1 falls. Not measured from video.
analytic_route.route_objective: sum log(1+normalized_onset_drive^2) at modeled geometric crossings minus disclosed sweep and duration penalties
analytic_route.observation_status: Only two-bank order/facing edges are visually supported. 21+21 points, spacing, tuning, orientation, span and reach are hypotheses.
analytic_route.silence_handling: One continuous analytic trajectory through all recording gaps. Gap events disabled. Contact ringing resets at recording silence; one initial state per observed pitch/mode per resume.
analytic_route.unmodeled_strings: All 42 spatial points are retained. Crossed strings outside the inherited six-pitch dictionary are explicitly assumed to have zero effective pluck. Gap 20..26 has no sound source.

modal_amplitude_frames.definition: Model modal envelope magnitudes rendered from parameters; not source FFT, source Z or recorded analysis. Equal-pitch bank responses are independent and add coherently.

two_bank_geometry.claim: All 42 latent points retained, not two six-note blocks pasted together. Pitch direction is independently hypothesized per bank; only facing edges connect.

audit.endpoint_law: C2 quintic with derivative ±(R-L)*30u²(1-u)²/T, strictly signed in each open half-cycle. Reverses only at endpoints; no independent stop or phase reset at recording gaps.
audit.physical_limits: No measured full string points, pitch orientation, endpoint reach or 3D contact. Spacings not length-calibrated. Speed50 and half-period2.0 are explicit search assumptions, not proven biological feasibility. The broader span must be crossed, with no interior string or gap jumps. Contacts outside six inherited pitch groups are assumed silent.
audit.silence_handling: One continuous analytic trajectory through all recording gaps. Gap events disabled. Contact ringing resets at recording silence; one initial state per observed pitch/mode per resume.

optional_contact_threshold.interpretation: Operational visualization threshold, not measured audibility or proof of real pluck.

audit.isolated_component_energy_caveat: These are component energies, not fractional source attribution; coherent components can cancel or reinforce.
